summary: Frontend-only regression verification for 12 newly added Base Components previews + 6 pending fallbacks on /design-system/components/base. Logged in via mock auth. All 12 new components (Button Group, Combobox, Data Table, Date Picker, Empty, Field, Input Group, Item, Kbd, Native Select, Spinner, Typography) opened their preview dialog and rendered a live preview with body children and NO 'not implemented' / 'not yet available' text. All 6 expected pending components (Attachment, Bubble, Marker, Message, Message Scroller, Direction) correctly show the 'This component is not yet available in the design system.' fallback. Stateful interactions verified: Combobox trigger opens searchable Command list, selecting 'Option Two' updates the trigger label to 'Option Two'. Date Picker trigger opens the Calendar popover (role=grid present, react-day-picker). Data Table renders exactly 3 tbody rows with Status column badges Active/Inactive/Active (via @tanstack/react-table). Base table remains visible and functional after opening/closing the dialogs in sequence. Zero pageerror events and zero console errors captured during the flow.
critical_code_review_comments: componentPreviews.jsx is now ~987 lines (up from ~835) — exceeds the 700-line soft threshold. Recommend splitting into per-category modules (e.g., previews/overlay.jsx, previews/forms.jsx, previews/data-display.jsx) and re-exporting a merged map. AdvancedPreviews.jsx is already a good precedent.

ComponentsPage.jsx: The fallback still uses two different phrasings ('not implemented yet' vs 'not yet available') across the two branches — inconsistency remains from iteration_1. Suggest a single canonical string.

DatePickerPreview: Popover does not auto-close after day selection (react-day-picker onSelect only calls setDate). Minor UX polish — consider adding setOpen(false) inside onSelect for parity with typical shadcn date-picker recipe.

AdvancedPreviews.jsx DataTablePreview: dtData/dtColumns are module-level constants which is fine, but consider useMemo inside the component for larger real-world tables to match tanstack/react-table best practice.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_1 covered 29 established + 3 pending previews. This iteration_2 covers the 12 newly added component previews + all 6 currently-pending fallbacks. Together with iteration_1 the coverage across all 63 rows is effectively complete (only a few low-risk established primitives — Accordion, Alert, Aspect Ratio, Avatar, Badge, Breadcrumb, Button, Card, Checkbox, Collapsible, Input, Label, Separator, Textarea, Toggle — remain unopened but are trivial static JSX). Combobox stateful select works; Date Picker calendar opens (react-day-picker) but popover doesn't auto-close on select (minor).
